text: Neftchi Fergana's official website lists the 'Fergana Region Administration' (Farg'ona viloyati hokimligi) — Uzbekistan's regional state administration, which issues local government decisions — among the club's main sponsors.
short: Neftchi lists the Fergana regional government (hokimlik) as a main sponsor.

source.name: PFK Neftchi — official website, homepage ('Our main sponsors' section)
source.note: The name appears under the homepage's 'Our main sponsors' section.

additionalSources.name: Farg'ona Invest Kompaniyasi AJ: Uzbekistan Republic, Fergana region hokim's decision 163-11-0-Q/26 (charter annexe)
additionalSources.note: Decision of the Fergana region hokim establishing the region's investment company, showing the hokimlik acting as a regional government body.
additionalSources.quote: Farg‘ona viloyati hokimligi muassisligida tadbirkorlik subyektlari va davlat organlari o‘rtasida “ko‘prik” vazifasini bajaruvchi “Farg‘ona invest kompaniyasi” aksiyadorlik jamiyati (keyingi o‘rinlarda —Kompaniya) tashkil etilsin.
